title: Governed Official/Regulator + Market Data Provider Evidence Merge and RRE Consumption
rules: Only already CWA-admitted RRE_ELIGIBLE DIRECT evidence may enter the merge.
The merge does not re-admit sources and does not alter authority class, domain, freshness, sourceId, claimId, laneId or provenance.
Authority classes remain distinct after merge; MARKET_DATA_PROVIDER is never promoted to REGULATOR, GOVERNMENT or OFFICIAL_PRIMARY.
Evidence count never determines authority. Source voting is forbidden.
Required-lane completeness is based on distinct lane IDs, not number of sources or claims.
Multiple evidence records in one lane increase lineage depth only; they do not create additional lanes.
Duplicate claimId is allowed only when the records are byte-semantically identical; conflicting duplicate IDs fail closed.
The original W8D official/regulator readout remains unchanged. W8D-P2 writes a separate enriched RRE readout.
Merged RRE consumption does not derive grammar, reality domain, runtime position, transition threshold or projection.
